PLAN "Post-Meniscus Return to Skiing Strength - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lower-body and posterior chain strength while protecting the right knee"
  GOAL secondary return_to_skiing:
    name "Restore quad, hip, and single-leg stability for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower A - Controlled Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Upper A - Push and Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Lower B - Single-Leg Foundations":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
          ankle_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hip_adduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
          butterfly_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper B - Shoulders and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
          external_rotation 2m
        main straight_sets:

          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

Note for the trainer: all lower-body loading uses no jumping, no plyometrics, and no deep knee flexion under load. Squat-pattern work (front_squat, goblet_squat, split_squat, lateral_lunge, step_up) should be taken to a pain-free depth set by the surgeon's clearance, and ROM should be checked before loading heavier than RPE 8. Confirm with the surgeon before progressing trap_bar_deadlift and front_squat past week 8, and get clearance before any ski-specific or lateral-movement work beyond this programme.
